note: Waivers are self-expiring, in BOTH directions. Each names the open PR that removes the problem: once `ownedByPr` is merged into the ref, the waiver itself becomes an error and must be deleted; if a waiver stops matching anything, that is an error too. An allow-list that cannot go stale is the only kind worth having -- see scripts/lib/doc-claims.mjs.

waivers.why: PR #113 re-points every `allowSubVaults = false` citation from Deploy.s.sol:77 to :79 and adds its own pin for them. Annotating the same four lines here would collide with that change for no gain.
